title: VisionFlow Ecosystem Release Manifest
description: Coordinated release manifest for the estate. Version 2 (2026-09-05, ADR-2006 closeout) widens the roster from six repositories to the fourteen in the ADR inventory, flags each one's provenance, and adds a `fixtures` block so a candidate cannot claim fixture parity it never checked.

repositories.description: Every inventoried repository. minItems is 14 — the count in docs/estate-review/evidence/adr-inventory.json. A manifest listing fewer is not a coordinated view of the estate; it is a coordinated view of part of it, which is what version 1 silently shipped.

present.description: Whether the checkout resolved at generation time. An absent repository is recorded with an all-zero head and branch "missing" rather than omitted.

provenance.description: first-party: authored and released by the estate. imported: a fork or adaptation of an external project, carried and modified here. upstream: an external project consumed as-is and not released by the estate. Release qualification applies to first-party and imported repositories; upstream repositories are pinned, not qualified.

upstream.description: The external project this repository derives from or tracks, when any.

role.description: What this repository contributes to the estate.

fixtures.description: Protocol-fixture qualification. A candidate or released manifest MUST carry status "compared" against a named canonical revision set; the generator refuses to emit one otherwise (exit 3).

repo.description: Roster name of the repository holding the canonical corpus.

revision.description: The resolved canonical revision. HEAD is resolved at generation time so the manifest names a commit, not a moving reference.

corpus_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the sorted "sha256␠filename" lines of the corpus. Two manifests agree iff they qualified against byte-identical fixtures.

verdict.description: match: every consumer copy equals the canonical corpus. drift: at least one differs. not-run: the comparison tool was unavailable in this environment.
